title: Anchor Week: One-Play Exec Brief
content:
Purpose: Rapid, lightweight runbook to align execs and leads for the first week of the quarter ("Anchor Week"). This is intentionally a one-play rehearsal: a single, small set of decisions and messages we practice end-to-end so the whole company learns cadence, asks, and fallback behavior.

Top-level goals for Anchor Week: 
- Confirm and communicate 3 company-level commitments for the quarter (clear, measurable, defensible).
- Validate rollout plan for 2 cross-org initiatives (Dedicated Capacity pricing experiment; Private deployments pilot).
- Rehearse all-hands Q&A flow and escalation runway with SRE/Legal on standby.

Quick outline (one page): 
1) Prework (Mon): exec 30-min sync. Bring: updated OKR drafts (see below), targeted customer impact stories, short outage/fallback plan.
2) Triage session (Tue morning): product + eng + go-to-market. Decide which minor ask to push live as the rehearsal trigger (we want a low-risk customer comms + metric to observe).
3) Exec update (Tue noon): 15-min recorded brief + 10-min live hot seat for 5 cross-function leads.
4) All-hands rehearsal (Wed): 45-min dry-run, distribution to hubs, collect FAQ. Rehearse handoff to CS for live customers.
5) Retrospective (Thu): 60-min quick retro, update playbook, publish short summary.

Draft company-level OKRs (for discussion) — short, measurable, tradeable: 
O1: Improve inference economics and adoption
KR1.1: Reduce average hosted per-token cost for mid-tail workloads by 18% vs baseline (monitored via Redwood Console token-cost report).
KR1.2: Grow Hosted conversion (free -> paid) from integration projects by 30% quarter-over-quarter.
KR1.3: Ship Optimize recommendations pipeline MVP and apply to 3 large customers (measured by recommendation adoption rate).

O2: Make Dedicated and Private ready for enterprise ramp
KR2.1: Achieve 99.5% p95 latency SLA for Dedicated across two workload profiles (small prompt / long chat).
KR2.2: Close 2 committed Dedicated contracts (>= $100k ARR each) and onboard with 7-day time-to-first-inference.
KR2.3: Deliver Private initial installation automation & KMS integration for 1 regulated customer pilot.

O3: Increase platform reliability and observability for customers
KR3.1: Reduce production incidents causing impact (customer-visible error rate) by 40% quarter-over-quarter.
KR3.2: Ship token-level traceability in Console with 90% of customer-facing routes instrumented.
KR3.3: Launch regression alerting tied to prompt sets for top 10 customers.

Decision points for Anchor Week (explicit asks to execs):
- Which KR stretch targets are negotiable vs critical? (Ops asks to mark KRs as A/B/C priority)
- Which single customer/feature will be used as the rehearsal trigger (we prefer a non-critical enterprise pilot with an internal champion)?
- Communication approval: legal to fast-review the all-hands script and customer comms within 24 hours.

All-hands script fragments (working draft):
- 0:00–5:00 — CEO framing: "Why this quarter matters" (three bullet commitments).
- 5:00–12:00 — Product lead demo: short demo of Optimize recommendations + brief on Dedicated latency improvements.
- 12:00–25:00 — Customer highlight: short recorded snippet + CS lead commentary.
- 25:00–35:00 — Operations update: what we tested in Anchor Week + SRE readiness.
- 35:00–45:00 — Live Q&A: 5 curated questions + 2 live audience spots.

Escalation & fallback map (concise):
- Customer-impacting comms blocked by legal: delay public comms, pivot to internal-only release, schedule follow-up.
- Performance regression during rehearsal: auto-fallback to smaller model variant + open incident bridge (SRE on call).
- Billing/pricing question unresolved: default to existing pricing for pilot customers, escalate to CFO for decision within 48h.

Open risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Running a live customer trigger in rehearsal could cause confusion. Mitigation: pick an internal test tenant + announce as "pilot" to external partner.
- Risk: Exec bandwidth for Monday prework is limited. Mitigation: pre-read memo containing one-page OKR proposals + data snapshots.

Owners and on-ramps (roles):
- Play owner (overall): Asha Patel (company-ops lead)
- OKR shepherds: Michael Chen (eng-serving-runtime) for O1; Priya Ramachandran (product-hosted-api) for O2; Lina Gomez (site-reliability-engineering) for O3.
- All-hands production: Jenna Park (developer-experience) + Noah Ruiz (growth)
- Legal/Compliance review: Rahul Mehta (security-and-compliance)

Short rehearsal checklist (to tick off Monday morning):
- [ ] OKR one-pager published to Confluence + shared with execs
- [ ] Rehearsal trigger selected and partner notified
- [ ] SRE & legal review windows booked (30 min each)
- [ ] Recording slot reserved and brief distributed to presenters
- [ ] CS playbook updated with customer messaging snippet

Communication artifacts to publish post-retro: 
- 1-page summary for company email (What, Why, What to expect this quarter)
- Updated OKRs in the company OKR tracker (link below)
- Short public FAQ for customers we touched during the pilot

Notes-to-self / loose threads (informal):
- Consider adding a small "quant of the week" for public metrics (latency or cost delta) to keep focus.
- If we hit a major incident, we should pause further rehearsals for 2 weeks.
- Need a tiny A/B test for "Optimize" language in customer comms: "cost-saving" vs "quality-aware optimizations".

References / linked artifacts (pre-reads): 
- Confluence: company-okrs-tracker (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OKRS/Company-OKRs)
- Jira epic for Anchor Week trigger: RED-9811 (https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-9811)
- GitHub PR for Optimize MVP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/pull/87

Expected outcomes by end of Anchor Week (concrete):
- Exec approvals for the 3 headline commitments or a prioritized list of edits.
- Two cross-org rollouts with a clear go/no-go for wider launch.
- Publishable all-hands recording and a one-paragraph company email.

Status: in_review.
